scope: UR1: dotnet, Node, JVM and Go tools resolve and run in the signed-in user's environment block and as that user (SignedInUserToolchain)

libraries.verified: 2026-11-08 UR1: Context7 /dotnet/docs returns nothing for CreateEnvironmentBlock or EnvironmentVariableTarget (gap; Microsoft Learn used). CreateEnvironmentBlock retrieves the environment variables for the specified user, the block a process started as that user receives, so commands are resolved against that user's PATH, JAVA_HOME, DOTNET_ROOT, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA and USERPROFILE. EnvironmentVariableTarget.Machine is stored in HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment, the same for every account, so the machine-target reads stay. Query: CreateEnvironmentBlock user environment; EnvironmentVariableTarget Machine.
